                bandCtx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                bandCtx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
                bandCtx.drawImage(src, 0, 0);
                bandCtx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
                bandCtx.drawImage(src, dx, dy);
                bandCtx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                return bandCanvas;
            }

                // 1. soft white field from particle positions
                fieldCtx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
                playground.drawFluid(fieldCtx);

                // 2. three nested crisp shells
                buildMask(bodyCtx, "goo-body");
                buildMask(coreCtx, "goo-core");
                buildMask(deepCtx, "goo-deep");

                // 3. edge band = body minus core (the thin surface shell)

                rimCtx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                rimCtx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
                rimCtx.drawImage(bodyCanvas, 0, 0);
                rimCtx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
                rimCtx.drawImage(coreCanvas, 0, 0);
                rimCtx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

                paintMasked(bodyCanvas, function(c){
                    let g = c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
                    g.addColorStop(0.0, "#6fcef4");
                    g.addColorStop(0.5, "#1c84c9");
                    g.addColorStop(1.0, "#08406f");
                    return g;
                });

                // B. thickness — the deeper the water, the darker & more saturated
                paintMasked(coreCanvas, "#0c4a86", 0.5);
                paintMasked(deepCanvas, "#062f54", 0.55);

                // C. underside shadow — darken the bottom edge of each body
                paintMasked(buildBand(bodyCanvas, 0, -8), "#04203c", 0.5, "source-over", 2);

                // D. inner refraction glow — faint light through the deep body
                paintMasked(deepCanvas, "#2db4e2", 0.12, "lighter", 6);

                // E. directional highlight — bright crescent on the top edge where
                //    the skylight hits, giving the body a rounded, lit-from-above 3D feel
                paintMasked(buildBand(coreCanvas, 4, 9), "#cdeeff", 0.5, "lighter", 3);

                // F. foam crest — soft white aeration riding the very top surface
                paintMasked(buildBand(bodyCanvas, 0, 7), function(c){
                    let g = c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
                    g.addColorStop(0.0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)");
                    g.addColorStop(1.0, "rgba(210,240,255,0.25)");
                    return g;
                }, 1, "source-over", 1);

                // G. glassy rim glint — thin additive sparkle along the lit edge,
                //    strong at top, gone underneath (no flat outline)
                paintMasked(rimCanvas, function(c){
                    let g = c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
                    g.addColorStop(0.0, "rgba(235,250,255,0.7)");
                    g.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(150,212,245,0.15)");
                    g.addColorStop(1.0, "rgba(110,190,235,0.0)");
                    return g;
                }, 1, "lighter", 0.5);

                // H. specular sheen — broad soft skylight reflection on the upper body
                paintMasked(coreCanvas, function(c){
                    let g = c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
                    g.addColorStop(0.0,  "rgba(255,255,255,0.30)");
                    g.addColorStop(0.16, "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)");
                    g.addColorStop(0.4,  "rgba(255,255,255,0.0)");
                    return g;
                }, 1, "lighter", 2);
            }

            let lastTime = performance.now();
            let currentTime = 0;
            let deltaTime = 0;

            let playground = new Playground();

            mainLoop();

            function updatePlayground(dt){
                playground.update(dt);

                ctx.fillStyle = "#242321";
                ctx.fillRect(0,0, W, H);

                renderWater();

                playground.draw();
            }

            function mainLoop(){
                window.requestAnimationFrame(mainLoop);
                currentTime = performance.now();
                deltaTime = (currentTime - lastTime) / 1000;
                updatePlayground(deltaTime);
                lastTime = currentTime;
            }

            function getMousePos(canvas, evt){
                var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                return { x: evt.clientX - rect.left, y: evt.clientY - rect.top };
            }

            canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(evt){
                let mouse = getMousePos(canvas,evt);
                playground.onMouseMove(new Vector2(mouse.x,mouse.y));
            }, false)
            canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(evt){ playground.onMouseDown(evt.button); }, false)
            canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', function(evt){ playground.onMouseUp(evt.button); }, false)
        </script>
    </body>
</html>

    <head>
        <title>2D Fluid Simulation</title>
        <style>
            * {padding: 0; margin: 0;}
            canvas { display: block; margin: 20px auto;}
            body {background: #242321;}
        </style>
    </head>

    <body>
        <canvas id="canvas" width="1280px" height="720px" style="border: solid 1px black"></canvas>
        <script src="Playground.js"></script>
        <script src="Simulation.js"></script>
        <script src="Vector2.js"></script>
        <script src="DrawUtils.js"></script>
        <script src="Particle.js"></script>
        <script src="FluidHashGrid.js"></script>
        <script src="ParticleEmitter.js"></script>
        <script src="Spring.js"></script>
        <script src="shapes/Shape.js"></script>
        <script src="shapes/Polygon.js"></script>
        <script src="shapes/Circle.js"></script>

        <script>
            var canvas = document.getElementById("canvas");
            var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

            // --- metaball fluid rendering pipeline ---
            // offscreen canvas: particles drawn as soft white blobs
            var particleCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
            particleCanvas.width = canvas.width;
            particleCanvas.height = canvas.height;
            var particleCtx = particleCanvas.getContext("2d");

            // offscreen canvas: final thresholded + tinted fluid surface
            var fluidCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
            fluidCanvas.width = canvas.width;
            fluidCanvas.height = canvas.height;
            var fluidCtx = fluidCanvas.getContext("2d");

            // pre-rendered soft white sprite (drawn once, reused per particle)
            var FLUID_RADIUS = 13;
            var spriteSize = 64;
            var fluidSprite = document.createElement("canvas");
            fluidSprite.width = spriteSize;
            fluidSprite.height = spriteSize;
            (function buildSprite(){
                let sctx = fluidSprite.getContext("2d");
                let g = sctx.createRadialGradient(spriteSize/2, spriteSize/2, 0, spriteSize/2, spriteSize/2, spriteSize/2);
                g.addColorStop(0.0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
                g.addColorStop(0.4, "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)");
                g.addColorStop(1.0, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
                sctx.fillStyle = g;
                sctx.fillRect(0,0,spriteSize,spriteSize);
            })();
            window.fluidSprite = fluidSprite;
            window.FLUID_RADIUS = FLUID_RADIUS;

            // metaball tuning
            var FLUID_BLUR = 10;       // px, controls how far blobs bleed together
            var FLUID_CONTRAST = 18;   // threshold sharpness; higher = crisper surface

            let lastTime = performance.now();
            let currentTime = 0;
            let deltaTime = 0;

            let playground = new Playground();

            mainLoop();

            function updatePlayground(dt){
                playground.update(dt);

                // 1. background
                ctx.fillStyle = "#242321";
                ctx.fillRect(0,0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

                // 2. draw particles as soft white blobs onto offscreen canvas
                particleCtx.clearRect(0,0, particleCanvas.width, particleCanvas.height);
                playground.drawFluid(particleCtx);

                // 3. metaball pass: blur neighbours together, contrast threshold
                //    creates crisp alpha mask, then tint it blue with a depth gradient
                fluidCtx.clearRect(0,0, fluidCanvas.width, fluidCanvas.height);
                fluidCtx.save();
                fluidCtx.filter = "blur(" + FLUID_BLUR + "px) contrast(" + FLUID_CONTRAST + ")";
                fluidCtx.drawImage(particleCanvas, 0, 0);
                fluidCtx.filter = "none";
                fluidCtx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-in";
                let depthGrad = fluidCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, fluidCanvas.height);
                depthGrad.addColorStop(0, "#5fc7ff");
                depthGrad.addColorStop(1, "#0a5a9e");
                fluidCtx.fillStyle = depthGrad;
                fluidCtx.fillRect(0, 0, fluidCanvas.width, fluidCanvas.height);
                fluidCtx.restore();

                // 4. composite the fluid surface onto the main canvas
                ctx.drawImage(fluidCanvas, 0, 0);

                // 5. draw obstacles & emitters crisply on top
                playground.draw();
            }

            function mainLoop(){
                window.requestAnimationFrame(mainLoop);

                currentTime = performance.now();
                deltaTime = (currentTime - lastTime) / 1000;

                updatePlayground(deltaTime);
                lastTime = currentTime;
            }

            function getMousePos(canvas, evt){
                var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                return {
                    x: evt.clientX - rect.left,
                    y: evt.clientY - rect.top
                };
            }

            canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(evt){
                let mouse = getMousePos(canvas,evt);
                playground.onMouseMove(new Vector2(mouse.x,mouse.y));
            }, false)

            canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function(evt){
                playground.onMouseDown(evt.button);
            }, false)

            canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', function(evt){
                playground.onMouseUp(evt.button);
            }, false)




        </script>
